attBesluta.text: Perfect proportions for standard European flats. Easy to clean, stable legs and cohesive look across all three tables. Arrived well packaged and undamaged.
Really solid build, no shaking or marks after months of daily use. Timeless wood and iron style works with almost any interior design.
Brilliant love them easy to assemble and very strong
Well-made, sturdy 3 piece table set with attractive wood and metal finish. Simple assembly, good size for most European apartments and living rooms.
Purchased these for my son’s first apartment. Quality exceeded my expectations for the cost and we are very happy with the purchase.
tavolini resistenti e ben fatti, montaggio facile, consigliatissimo

I had to do a 4/5 because for whatever reason, the company stuck 2 heavy duty stickers on the face of the table. The stickiness took me 2 days to wipe off. If they would have stuck them on the bottom of the table, I would have just left them. Very stupid.
